verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’el- way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־ אִשָּׁ֗ה יַפְלִא֙ לִנְדֹּר֙ נֶ֣דֶר נָזִ֔יר לְהַזִּ֖יר לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ’îš ’ōw- ’iš·šāh yap̄·li lin·dōr ne·ḏer nā·zîr lə·haz·zîr Yah·weh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow the vow of a Nazirite to separate himself to the LORD

verses.original: יַזִּ֔יר מִיַּ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְחֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְכָל־ עֲנָבִים֙ מִשְׁרַ֤ת יֹאכֵֽל׃ לַחִ֥ים וַעֲנָבִ֛ים וִיבֵשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: yaz·zîr mî·ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār lō yiš·teh ḥō·meṣ ya·yin wə·ḥō·meṣ šê·ḵār lō yiš·teh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·nā·ḇîm miš·raṯ yō·ḵêl la·ḥîm wa·‘ă·nā·ḇîm wî·ḇê·šîm lō
verses.literal: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink He must not drink vinegar made from wine . . . [or] strong drink and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins . . .

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל מִכֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃ יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה מִגֶּ֣פֶן הַיַּ֗יִן מֵחַרְצַנִּ֛ים וְעַד־ זָ֖ג
verses.transliteration: kōl mik·kōl ’ă·šer yə·mê niz·rōw lō yō·ḵêl yê·‘ā·śeh mig·ge·p̄en hay·ya·yin mê·ḥar·ṣan·nîm wə·‘aḏ- zāḡ
verses.literal: All the days of his separation he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine . . . not even the seeds or skins

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵי֙ נֶ֣דֶר נִזְר֔וֹ לֹא־ תַּ֖עַר יַעֲבֹ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ יִהְיֶ֔ה קָדֹ֣שׁ עַד־ הַיָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר־ יַזִּ֤יר לַיהוָה֙ מְלֹ֨את שְׂעַ֥ר רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃ גַּדֵּ֥ל פֶּ֖רַע
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê ne·ḏer niz·rōw lō- ta·‘ar ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- rō·šōw yih·yeh qā·ḏōš ‘aḏ- hay·yā·mim ’ă·šer- yaz·zîr Yah·weh mə·lōṯ śə·‘ar rō·šōw gad·dêl pe·ra‘
verses.literal: For the entire period of his vow of separation no razor shall touch . . . his head He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete he must let the hair of his head grow long

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י הַזִּיר֖וֹ לַיהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָבֹֽא׃ עַל־ מֵ֖ת נֶ֥פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê haz·zî·rōw Yah·weh lō yā·ḇō ‘al- mêṯ ne·p̄eš
verses.literal: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD he must not go near a dead body

verses.original: לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֗וֹ לְאָחִיו֙ וּלְאַ֣חֹת֔וֹ בְּמֹתָ֑ם לֹא־ יִטַּמָּ֥א לָהֶ֖ם כִּ֛י נֵ֥זֶר אֱלֹהָ֖יו עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·lə·’im·mōw lə·’ā·ḥîw ū·lə·’a·ḥō·ṯōw bə·mō·ṯām lō- yiṭ·ṭam·mā lā·hem kî nê·zer ’ĕ·lō·hāw ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die he is not to defile himself because the symbol of consecration to his God is upon his head

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ ה֖וּא קָדֹ֥שׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōl yə·mê niz·rōw hū qā·ḏōš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Throughout the time . . . of his separation he is holy to the LORD

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ בְּפֶ֣תַע פִּתְאֹ֔ם יָמ֨וּת מֵ֤ת עָלָיו֙ וְטִמֵּ֖א רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְגִלַּ֤ח רֹאשׁוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם טָהֳרָת֔וֹ יְגַלְּחֶֽנּוּ׃ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י בַּיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- bə·p̄e·ṯa‘ piṯ·’ōm yā·mūṯ mêṯ ‘ā·lāw wə·ṭim·mê rōš niz·rōw wə·ḡil·laḥ rō·šōw bə·yō·wm ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw yə·ḡal·lə·ḥen·nū haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bay·yō·wm
verses.literal: If someone suddenly . . . dies . . . in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing - the seventh day

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י וּבַיּ֣וֹם יָבִא֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·mî·nî ū·ḇay·yō·wm yā·ḇi šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶחָ֤ד לְחַטָּאת֙ וְאֶחָ֣ד לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֔יו מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עַל־ הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ הַהֽוּא׃ בַּיּ֥וֹם וְקִדַּ֥שׁ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·‘ā·śāh ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw mê·’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā ‘al- han·nā·p̄eš ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·qid·daš ’eṯ- rō·šōw
verses.literal: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body On that day he must consecrate - his head again

verses.original: וְהִזִּ֤יר יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ לַֽיהוָה֙ אֶת־ וְהֵבִ֛יא בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֖וֹ כֶּ֥בֶשׂ לְאָשָׁ֑ם הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ וְהַיָּמִ֤ים יִפְּל֔וּ כִּ֥י נִזְרֽוֹ׃ טָמֵ֖א
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zîr yə·mê niz·rōw Yah·weh ’eṯ- wə·hê·ḇî ben- šə·nā·ṯōw ke·ḇeś lə·’ā·šām hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hay·yā·mîm yip·pə·lū kî niz·rōw ṭā·mê
verses.literal: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD - and bring a year-old . . . male lamb as a guilt offering But the preceding days shall not be counted because his separation was defiled

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַנָּזִ֑יר בְּי֗וֹם יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ מְלֹאת֙ יָבִ֣יא אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ han·nā·zîr bə·yō·wm yə·mê niz·rōw mə·lōṯ yā·ḇî ’ō·ṯōw ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete He must be brought - to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֣וֹ לַיהוָ֡ה אֶחָד֙ תָמִ֤ים בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֨וֹ כֶּבֶשׂ֩ לְעֹלָ֔ה אַחַ֧ת תְּמִימָ֖ה בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֛הּ וְכַבְשָׂ֨ה לְחַטָּ֑את אֶחָ֥ד תָּמִ֖ים וְאַֽיִל־ לִשְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ’e·ḥāḏ ṯā·mîm ben- šə·nā·ṯōw ke·ḇeś lə·‘ō·lāh ’a·ḥaṯ tə·mî·māh baṯ- šə·nā·ṯāh wə·ḵaḇ·śāh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’e·ḥāḏ tā·mîm wə·’a·yil- liš·lā·mîm
verses.literal: and he is to present - an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old . . . male lamb as a burnt offering an unblemished year-old . . . female lamb as a sin offering and an unblemished ram as a peace offering

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתָ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ וְסַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת חַלֹּת֙ סֹ֤לֶת בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן מַצּ֖וֹת וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem wə·sal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ḥal·lōṯ sō·leṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·še·men maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·rə·qî·qê mə·šu·ḥîm baš·šā·men
verses.literal: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְהִקְרִ֥יב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ וְאֶת־ עֹלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·rîḇ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make - the sin offering and the burnt offering

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה הָאַ֜יִל זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל סַ֣ל הַמַּצּ֑וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־ וְעָשָׂה֙ מִנְחָת֖וֹ וְאֶת־ נִסְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ya·‘ă·śeh hā·’a·yil ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh ‘al sal ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·‘ā·śāh min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- nis·kōw
verses.literal: - He shall also offer the ram vvv as a peace offering to the LORD along with the basket of unleavened bread And the priest - is to offer the accompanying grain offering - and drink offering

verses.original: פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד הַנָּזִ֗יר וְגִלַּ֣ח נִזְר֑וֹ רֹ֣אשׁ אֶת־ וְלָקַ֗ח אֶת־ שְׂעַר֙ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֔וֹ וְנָתַן֙ עַל־ הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֖חַת זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ han·nā·zîr wə·ḡil·laḥ niz·rōw rōš ’eṯ- wə·lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- śə·‘ar rōš niz·rōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- hā·’êš ’ă·šer- ta·ḥaṯ ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head - take - the hair - - and put it on the fire - under vvv the peace offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ וְלָקַ֨ח בְּשֵׁלָה֮ הַזְּרֹ֣עַ מִן־ הָאַיִל֒ אַחַת֙ מַצָּ֤ה וְֽחַלַּ֨ת מִן־ הַסַּ֔ל אֶחָ֑ד מַצָּ֖ה וּרְקִ֥יק וְנָתַן֙ עַל־ כַּפֵּ֣י הַנָּזִ֔יר אַחַ֖ר הִֽתְגַּלְּח֥וֹ אֶת־ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·lā·qaḥ bə·šê·lāh haz·zə·rō·a‘ min- hā·’a·yil ’a·ḥaṯ maṣ·ṣāh wə·ḥal·laṯ min- has·sal ’e·ḥāḏ maṣ·ṣāh ū·rə·qîq wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- kap·pê han·nā·zîr ’a·ḥar hiṯ·gal·lə·ḥōw ’eṯ- niz·rōw
verses.literal: And the priest - is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram one unleavened cake from the basket and one unleavened wafer and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved - [the hair of] his consecration

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֥ן׀ וְהֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨ם תְּנוּפָה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ הוּא֙ קֹ֤דֶשׁ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֚ל חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֑ה וְאַחַ֛ר הַנָּזִ֖יר יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hê·nîp̄ ’ō·w·ṯām tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh hū qō·ḏeš lak·kō·hên ‘al ḥă·zêh hat·tə·nū·p̄āh wə·‘al šō·wq hat·tə·rū·māh wə·’a·ḥar han·nā·zîr yiš·teh yā·yin
verses.literal: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD This is a holy portion for the priest in addition to the breast of the wave offering . . . and the thigh that was presented After that the Nazirite may drink wine

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַנָּזִיר֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּר֒ קָרְבָּנ֤וֹ לַֽיהוָה֙ עַל־ נִזְר֔וֹ מִלְּבַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־ תַּשִּׂ֣יג יָד֑וֹ כְּפִ֤י יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְרוֹ֙ יִדֹּ֔ר כֵּ֣ן עַ֖ל תּוֹרַ֥ת נִזְרֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ han·nā·zîr ’ă·šer yid·dōr qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh ‘al- niz·rōw mil·lə·ḇaḏ ’ă·šer- taś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw kə·p̄î ya·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer niḏ·rōw yid·dōr kên ‘al tō·w·raṯ niz·rōw
verses.literal: This [is] the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation in addition to whatever else he can afford . . . . . . he must fulfill whatever vow he makes vvv according to the law of his separation

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה תְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמ֖וֹר לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr kōh ṯə·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·mō·wr lā·hem
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons This is how you are to bless - the Israelites . . . Say to them

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā wə·yiš·mə·re·ḵā
verses.literal: May the LORD bless you and keep you

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה׀ פָּנָ֛יו יָאֵ֨ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ וִֽיחֻנֶּֽךָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh pā·nāw yā·’êr ’ê·le·ḵā wî·ḥun·ne·kā
verses.literal: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ יִשָּׂ֨א פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiś·śā pā·nāw ’ê·le·ḵā wə·yā·śêm lə·ḵā šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace

verses.original: וְשָׂמ֥וּ אֶת־ שְׁמִ֖י עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲנִ֖י אֲבָרֲכֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·mū ’eṯ- šə·mî ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·nî ’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵêm
verses.literal: So they shall put - My name on the Israelites . . . and I will bless them
